name: mirage
text: Released v1.0.37: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.37 . It adds the sharp-confirmed bid step-down (margin falls from 4% to 1.5% under the sharp book as the game nears, for bids with a fresh sharp read). With v1.0.36 (faster bid desk, API manager fixes) you now have everything.
